lines.zh: 我小跑在森林的落叶上
lines.en: I trot over the forest's fallen leaves

lines.zh: 三条同族一起，踩着同一个节奏
lines.en: Three of my kind, stepping to one rhythm
My legs are thin, and quick

lines.zh: 我抬着头，脖子一伸一伸
lines.en: I keep my head up, my neck bobbing
Twigs snap underfoot, I ignore them
I slip between the roots

lines.zh: 尾巴平平地伸着，平衡用
lines.en: My tail stretches level, for balance

lines.zh: 我们一群散开走，又聚回来
lines.en: We fan out and regather
The leaves are deep, I have to pick my steps
I pause to listen to the forest

lines.zh: 前面的那只回头看了我一眼
lines.en: The one ahead glances back at me
I run with my mouth open

lines.zh: 我绕过一根倒木，没有停
lines.en: I go around a fallen log without stopping

lines.zh: 跑起来的时候，尾巴不打弯
lines.en: When I run, my tail does not bend

lines.zh: 我站在树影里，只有一条腿动
lines.en: I stand in the tree shade, one leg twitching

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，藏起来容易
lines.en: A body this small is easy to hide

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见树上有东西
lines.en: I look up, there is something in the tree

lines.zh: 同族在几步外，各自站着
lines.en: My kin stand a few steps away, each alone
When the wind passes, I turn my head

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腿，挠了挠脖子
lines.en: I lift a leg and scratch my neck
An insect is crawling on the ground
I stay still, at most one blink
The forest is full of sounds

lines.zh: 我四五只一起，谁也不挨着谁
lines.en: Four or five of us, none touching

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上轻轻刮
lines.en: My claws scrape lightly on the ground
I sniff the air, nothing

lines.zh: 我把头转向有声音的一边
lines.en: I turn my head toward the sound

lines.zh: 我在一块温石头上歇着
lines.en: I rest on a warm stone
You are so large, I have to look up
I tilt my head and look with one eye

lines.zh: 你脚下踩着的树叶，我刚才在
lines.en: The leaves under your feet, I was there just now
I am not afraid, I am fast
Come closer and I back two steps
Several of us are watching you
Is that thing good to eat

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就更好奇了
lines.en: Crouching makes me more curious

lines.zh: 我抬了一下头，又低下去
lines.en: I raise my head once and lower it
Standing like that, I have not seen it

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的味道，很浓
lines.en: Your smell is very strong
I let out one short cry
I roll into the leaves
My leg will not quite obey
With this wound I can still run
I retreat a few steps and stop
My kin glance at me and scatter
Small frame, same pain
I spit a little blood on the leaves
I will not cry out twice
Your hand is quicker than I thought
Is that meat in your hand

lines.zh: 三只同伴挨着我，也想吃。
lines.en: Three of my pack press close, also hungry.
That is not enough for several of us
Put it down and I will come
I am quick, and careful

lines.zh: 同族在看着，我不能先动
lines.en: My kin are watching, I cannot move first
That smell pulls me forward
I take a bite and retreat
Do not snatch, I was here first

lines.zh: 你一碰，我就滚到落叶里
lines.en: One touch and I roll into the leaves
I spring up and dart three steps away
You are so heavy, I am so light
I retreat, and my kin scatter too
That left my leg a bit off
I am right underfoot, do not tread

lines.zh: 我从你两腿之间穿过去
lines.en: I dart between your legs
Leaves fly up under my feet
I circle and come to a stop
Touch again and I run far
We few are one pack
First, let us see who runs fastest

lines.zh: 我抖了抖脖子上的颜色
lines.en: I shake the colors on my neck
There are many of my kind in this forest
I come a little closer and move away

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候才好说话
lines.en: Eating is a good time to talk

lines.zh: 你再过来，同族就围上了
lines.en: Come closer and my kin will gather
That is for all of us
I will run a circle, can you keep up
Let me look first, no hurry
I take up a small piece
It is bigger than my mouth
I carry it two steps off
There are more under the leaves
My kin are closing in
I hide it behind a root
I run back to look again
With it in my mouth, I cannot speak
Something moved beyond the trees
I lift my head, neck extended
Several of us turn at once

lines.zh: 你踩断的那根枝，我听见了
lines.en: I heard the branch you snapped

lines.zh: 这身子里没多少肉，可我也不怕
lines.en: There is not much meat on me, and I am not afraid

lines.zh: 我往前跑了两步，又停下
lines.en: I run two steps and stop
I gave a short cry
The kin around me have all stopped

lines.zh: 你的影子已经到我这了
lines.en: Your shadow has already reached me
I lower my head, tail straight

lines.zh: 一只在左边，一只在右边
lines.en: One on the left, one on the right
I press low and stretch my neck forward

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，隔着落叶
lines.en: I follow behind you across the leaves
You walk fast, I run easily

lines.zh: 我们几只，从几个方向来
lines.en: Several of us, from several sides

lines.zh: 林子里全是我们的脚印
lines.en: The forest is full of our prints

lines.zh: 你回头，我们已经散开了
lines.en: Look back and we have scattered
I have got ahead of you
I know this forest better than you

lines.zh: 你越走越深，树越来越密
lines.en: The deeper you go, the thicker the trees
One call and my kin will come
You land too heavily
We only bite as high as the calf

lines.zh: 树叶一直在动，你分不清
lines.en: The leaves keep moving, you cannot tell
In a while you will tire
There is no stone on this path

lines.zh: 我从落叶上跑过，没有声音
lines.en: I run over the leaves without a sound
One goes left, one goes right
I stay at the front
I bite down on your ankle
The teeth are small, and many
I leap and claw once
Not heavy, but it bleeds
I come from behind
Raise your hand and I run
Several of us go at once
You have been bitten several times
I pull back, another comes in
That did not bite through
Your feet have lost their order
I run off with blood in my mouth
The stones will not find me
We pick one place to bite
Your boots are too thick
A little closer and we can reach
One has come out from under the leaves

lines.zh: 我们几只一起从树后出来
lines.en: Several of us step from behind the trees

lines.zh: 林子里的枯枝响了一声
lines.en: A dead branch sounded in the forest
I poke my head out from behind a root
Several sets of small prints on the ground

lines.zh: 这片林子本来就有我们
lines.en: This forest always had us
I barely made a sound coming down
One called, and the others answered

lines.zh: 我抬脚，踩在一片落叶上
lines.en: I lift a foot and set it on a leaf

lines.zh: 一只先出来，其余的跟着
lines.en: One comes out before the rest

lines.zh: 鼻子里闻到的是新叶的味道
lines.en: What I smell is fresh leaves

lines.zh: 树影里多了几个小影子
lines.en: Several small shadows in the tree shade
We gather at the forest edge

lines.zh: 我踩在苔藓上，脚有点滑
lines.en: My feet slip a little on the moss
There are five or six in this group
The fire came and the leaves burned first

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下去，摔在叶子上
lines.en: I fell from the tree into the leaves
The water is deep and my legs will not kick

lines.zh: 小身板被炸得翻进蕨丛。
lines.en: My small body is blown into the ferns.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，把我钉在树根上
lines.en: An arrow grazed and pinned me to a root
That force made my legs weak
There is nothing left to eat in the forest

lines.zh: 雷打在树顶，整片林子都亮了
lines.en: Lightning hit the treetop and the whole forest lit up
